events.description: Ross Geller says Ross Geller stopped for a Chunky candy bar.
Carol Willick says Ross Geller should let the issue go.
Susan Bunch says Susan Bunch got an extra Chunky candy bar.
Susan Bunch asks whether Ross Geller wants the extra Chunky candy bar.
Dr. Franzblau asks how Ross Geller, Susan Bunch, and Carol Willick are doing.
Dr. Franzblau says Dr. Franzblau understands that Carol Willick is thinking of having a baby, Ben Geller.
Dr. Franzblau says Dr. Franzblau sees that Carol Willick is nine months pregnant and says that being nine months pregnant is a good start.
Dr. Franzblau asks how Carol Willick is doing with Carol Willick's contractions.
Carol Willick says Carol Willick loves the contractions.
Carol Willick says each contraction is like a little party in Carol Willick's uterus.
Susan Bunch says the contractions occur every four minutes and last 55 seconds.
Carol Willick asks if Carol Willick is allowed to drink anything.
Dr. Franzblau says the ice chips are at the nurses' station.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller will get the ice chips.
Susan Bunch says Susan Bunch is getting the ice chips.
Susan Bunch says Susan Bunch will be right back.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green thought that Carol Willick might like some ice chips.
Rachel Green asks whether Carol Willick needs anything else.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green does not believe that Rachel Green and Dr. Franzblau have met before.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is Rachel Green and is Carol Willick's ex-husband Ross Geller's sister Monica Geller's roommate.
Dr. Franzblau says it is nice to meet Rachel Green and says Dr. Franzblau is meeting Rachel Green.
Dr. Franzblau says Dr. Franzblau is Dr. Franzblau and is Monica Geller's brother Ross Geller's ex-wife Carol Willick's obstetrician.
Rachel Green says Dr. Franzblau's joke is funny.
